whatsapp_notice_title: You'll get a WhatsApp message with your order details
whatsapp_notice_body: On {phone}. Reply {one} to confirm the order or {two} if you want to cancel it.
confirmation_sent_to: We sent the order confirmation details to {email}.
onboarding_success: Your test order was created successfully! 🎉
onboarding_body: You can now finish setting up your store from the dashboard.
transfer_request_body: You've received a request to transfer ownership of your order ({id}). If you agree to this request, you can accept the transfer by clicking the button below.
transfer_request_responsibility: Once you accept, the new owner will take on all responsibilities and permissions related to this order.
transfer_request_ignore: If you don't recognise this request or want to keep ownership, no action is needed.
transfer_accepted_body: Order {id} has been transferred to the new owner.
transfer_accept_failed: Something went wrong while accepting the transfer. Please try again.
transfer_declined_body: The transfer of order {id} has been declined.
transfer_decline_failed: Something went wrong while declining the transfer. Please try again.
